why_agent_cannot: try the URL in your own browser
what_human_must_do: The page did not load. Try the URL yourself; record 403/404 in fetch-report.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://www.xstable.ai/trade   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: Check that XStable is open where you live. Blocked visitors see this message: "Due to regulatory requirements, XStable is not available in your current location." No country list is published.
Open xstable.ai and connect a Solana wallet.
Deposit USDT or USDC on Solana. The app says: "Please select the Solana network only."

Trade small, with low leverage. Warning XStable's own help page says: "CFD trading carries a high level of risk. Prices may fluctuate significantly and you may lose your entire investment." At 500x, a price move of about 0.2% against you is enough to wipe out the margin on a trade.
Copy your referral link if you want the commission, and watch the points page for the launch.
